jobs.title: VP, Treasurer
jobs.description:
Job Summary
What is your next big career move? If it involves shaping global financial strategy, strengthening enterprise resilience, and creating long-term value, we should talk.

Job Description

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Finance empowers strategic decisions through expertise, fuels sustainable growth by delivering insights, manages risk, and drives value across global operations.

The Vice President, Treasurer is a senior finance executive responsible for leading IFF’s global treasury strategy and operations. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, this leader will oversee capital structure, liquidity, cash management, debt and investments, foreign exchange, banking relationships, working capital, enterprise risk management, insurance, pension-related funding support, and treasury governance.

The role is based in our HQ in NYC.
Be part of a strategic, collaborative, and globally connected team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration. Where You’ll Make a Difference
- Develop and execute a global treasury strategy aligned with IFF’s enterprise priorities, financial objectives, and capital allocation framework.
- Lead capital structure planning, liquidity management, debt portfolio strategy, refinancing activities, capital markets transactions, and the investment of excess cash.
- Oversee global cash positioning, forecasting, repatriation, intercompany funding, short-term investments, and liquidity planning.
- Partner with business and finance leaders to deliver sustainable working capital improvement across receivables, inventory, payables, and cash conversion.
- Lead financial risk management programs, including foreign exchange, interest rate, counterparty, and other relevant financial exposures, together with related hedging policies, controls, and reporting.
- Oversee IFF’s enterprise insurance program and partner across Legal, Risk, Operations, and external advisors to ensure coverage is aligned with the company’s risk profile and business priorities.
- Support and strengthen enterprise risk management, treasury governance, policies, controls, compliance, and Board-level reporting.
- Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and executive leadership on financing strategy, capital allocation, market conditions, rating agency engagement, and financial risk.
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global treasury organization while modernizing systems, analytics, automation, reporting, and operating models.

What Makes You the Right Fit
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- At least 15 years of progressive experience across treasury, corporate finance, capital markets, banking, risk management, or related finance disciplines.
- At least 10 years in senior treasury leadership roles, preferably within a complex global public company.
- Demonstrated leadership of global cash management, liquidity planning, debt financing, capital markets transactions, hedging, banking relationships, and rating agency engagement.
- Strong knowledge of enterprise risk management, insurance, working capital, capital allocation, financial controls, regulatory requirements, and treasury technology.
- Proven ability to advise senior executives and communicate complex financial topics clearly to Board-level stakeholders.
- Experience leading global teams through transformation, complexity, and change.
- Strong financial judgment, enterprise mindset, cross-functional partnership skills, and the ability to connect treasury priorities to broader business performance.
- High standards of integrity, governance, accountability, and prudent risk management.

How Would You Stand Out?
- MBA, master’s degree, or another advanced finance-related degree.
- CTP, CFA, CPA, or an equivalent treasury, finance, risk management, or accounting credential.
- Leadership experience beyond treasury, such as Corporate FP&A, business finance, controllership, tax, investor relations, procurement finance, or finance transformation.

Why Choose Us?
- Influence IFF’s global financial strategy, resilience, and long-term value creation.
- Partner directly with the Chief Financial Officer, executive leadership, and Board-level stakeholders.
- Lead a global function with broad impact across capital allocation, cash generation, risk, and enterprise performance.
- Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Procurement, Supply Chain, and business leadership on critical priorities.
- Shape the modernization of treasury processes, technology, analytics, and operating models.
- Competitive benefits and pay

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

jobs.title: Global Treasury Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Are you ready to lead treasury operations excellence and drive transformation across a global organization?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.

The role is based in Asturias, Spain (hybrid role). Be part of a strategic, collaborative, and results-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

As the Global Treasury Operations Manager, you will lead and continuously improve treasury operations on a global scale, ensuring efficient, compliant, and best-in-class performance across the organization. You will oversee critical treasury processes, maintain robust governance and controls, optimize treasury technologies, and partner with internal and external stakeholders to enhance operational effectiveness and support business objectives.

For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.

Where You'll Make a Difference
- Drive and optimize global treasury operations, ensuring efficient cash positioning, liquidity management, and settlement activities across the organization.
- Develop, implement, and maintain treasury policies, procedures, and controls that support a compliant and high-performing operating environment.
- Lead initiatives to enhance treasury systems, technologies, and reporting capabilities, driving automation and operational excellence.
- Partner with internal stakeholders, banking partners, and external providers to improve treasury processes and strengthen operational effectiveness.
- Ensure compliance with financial regulations, internal controls, corporate governance requirements, and treasury risk management frameworks.
- Lead treasury-related projects, including technology implementations, process improvement initiatives, and merger and acquisition integration activities.
- Deliver insightful reporting and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making and treasury performance monitoring.
- Build, develop, and mentor treasury teams, fostering collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.
- Champion the adoption of treasury best practices and innovative solutions to strengthen service delivery, controls, and overall treasury effectiveness.

What Makes You the Right Fit?
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in treasury management, cash management, financial analysis, or related financial functions.
- Strong expertise in global treasury operations, cash management, liquidity structures, banking services, and treasury processes.
- Deep understanding of financial risk management, compliance frameworks, internal controls, and international treasury regulations.
- Experience working with treasury management systems, financial technologies, and reporting tools.
- Proven leadership experience managing teams and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and project management capabilities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a global and multicultural environment.
- Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

How Would You Stand Out?
- Professional treasury or finance certifications such as Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Associate Member of Corporate Treasurers (AMCT), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), or Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
- Experience leading treasury transformation, system implementation, automation, or digitalization projects.
- Strong background supporting complex global organizations through acquisitions, integrations, or large-scale business transformation initiatives.

Why Choose Us?
- Hybrid work environment that promotes flexibility and work-life balance.
- Opportunity to shape and enhance treasury operations across a global organization.
- Exposure to senior leaders and international stakeholders across multiple business functions and regions.
- Leadership of high-impact projects focused on treasury technology, automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
- A collaborative environment committed to innovation, development, and world-class treasury practices.
- Access to training, learning, and career development opportunities that support long-term professional growth.

jobs.title: Financial Planning and Analysis Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Are you ready to turn data into impactful business decisions and shape financial performance across EMEA?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
Our Food Ingredients business , the largest segment within IFF with over $3B in sales, brings together science, creativity, and deep customer collaboration to deliver solutions the world craves. Within this dynamic environment, our Ingredients Business Finance team plays a pivotal role in enabling data-driven decision-making, enhancing business performance, and supporting long-term strategy execution.

You will be part of the Ingredients Business Finance team, where we help our organization to take better, timely and data-driven decisions – through insightful reporting, in-depth analysis, business acumen and process improvement - making our BU´s and company more successful.

The role is based in Oviedo, Asturias, Spain (hybrid role) . Be part of a collaborative, analytical, and high-impact team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
